commands.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a15877bdb338a54d1bc30885b876c9e8f1459494"; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PKG=io.blueeye; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {n++} END {print n+0}')" -eq 1; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1)" = "$SERIAL"; model=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo device_model=$model; case "$model" in SM-S906*) ;; *) exit 3;; esac; dump(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-alert-state.xml >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out cat /sdcard/tracker-alert-state.xml > /tmp/tracker-alert-state.xml; }; tap_node(){ attr=$1; value=$2; dump; coords=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py /tmp/tracker-alert-state.xml "$attr" "$value"); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap $coords; sleep 1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null; sleep 2; tap_node content-desc Menu; tap_node text Settings; tap_node text 'Alerts & Collection'; dump; sed 's/></>\n</g' /tmp/tracker-alert-state.xml | grep -E 'text="(Tracker Detection|Vibration|Sound|Heads-Up Notification)"|checkable="true"' | head -n 40; echo PHASE3_ALERT_SETTINGS_STATE_PROBE_PASS
